data.one_liner: A Flutter package that helps you create a verification input field.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable verification code input widget that supports features like multi-box digit entry, copy/pasting entire codes, clearing inputs, and callbacks for completion and editing states.
use_when: You need an OTP (One-Time Password) or SMS verification code entry screen
You want customized underlined or boxed verification inputs with copy-paste support
avoid_when: You need complex form validation libraries beyond standard text input entry
strengths: Supports copy/pasting the entire verification code
Customizable styling including underline color, box borders, cursor color, and text style
Handles backspace navigation between boxes easily
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic examples and README
